_doc: Test manifest v2 for tools/pipeline.mjs. One row per runnable file under extension/tools plus helper-test. Built from the QUARANTINE table (byHand is authoritative there) and the source scan in lib-select.mjs (lane, headed, python are checked against it by test-pipeline-manifest; an `overrides` entry with a reason skips one field). Lanes are the only scheduler axis; the old stage names live on as stage:<name> tags and --stage aliases for one release. Timeouts are null until measured (timeoutSource guess = the lane default).

gate.doc: executes no product code (text, structure, tsc, git)

headed.doc: lib-launch / lib-test-window / test-next-primary (transitive) or headless:false; serial, secondary monitor

measure.doc: wall-clock and perf; serial, alone, report-only

smoke.doc: preflight, manifest check, incremental tsc, node --check closure, zip boot (headless-new), canary set

e2e.doc: headless first, then headed serial; headlessOk rows run headless; sweeps in chunks of 60

full.doc: every reachable suite; measure report-only; byHand per QUARANTINE; the only delivery candidate with release

release.doc: suites tagged release plus the ledger check; refuses ready while a human check is below the manifest version

stageAliases.note: --stage <name> = tag stage:<name>, kept for one release

pendingNote: empty after the 1012 integration; list ids here only for a lane that lands a test without its row (expires with pendingExpires).

python:hard.reason: Windows Application Control can block uv python (os error 4551)
python:hard.note: per-row pythonVia says which probe applies: uv (this one) or plain python
python:hard.verdict: ENV-BLOCKED (never green; tier INCOMPLETE unless --accept-env python)

python:soft.note: the suite prints its own skip / NOT VERIFIED line; the pipeline records it as degraded

secondary-monitor.onMissing: headed suites refuse to run unless --allow-primary; never silently use the main monitor

hubNote: a changed hub file escalates --changed to the whole regression tier (G-23); en.json / ar.json also add i18nParity (G-25). --changed never satisfies the delivery gate (G-24).

sourceScope.note: every .js/.mjs/.json/.html/.css under extension/ (node_modules, dist and tools/film output are never walked) must be reached by a suite (the import graph) or be on unmappedOk with a reason; docs, icons and store assets are not in this set

owner notes and decisions: not product

the delivery-gate runner itself (kept in parallel with pipeline.mjs for one release, D-1010-67)
